summary: Trinity Biotech plc filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release on July 2, 2026, announcing clinical trial data for its CGM+ multi-sensor wearable biosensor platform. The release discusses study results showing the system distinguishes nocturnal compression-related false low glucose events from true hypoglycemia, based on 5,000 hours of wear data from a pre-pivotal trial. No financial terms, transaction, or corporate actions are mentioned—only product development updates. As a routine operational disclosure of clinical data, this does not constitute a special situation under event-driven categories.
